headline: Chinese Carmakers Lose Ground in Türkiye Amid Tariff and Import Rules
summary: Chinese automotive brands suffered sharp declines in Türkiye amid additional customs duties and stricter import requirements.
why: Tariff adjustments and non-tariff trade barriers directly alter competitive dynamics in domestic automotive markets. Protectionist measures protect local manufacturing and European imports at the expense of foreign entrants.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Higher import duties restrict market share for imported Chinese vehicles while favoring local production.
